metadata.title: FrameGuesser • Test Your Movie Knowledge
metadata.description: A cinematographic puzzle game where users guess movies from obscured frames. Built with Next.js, Tailwind CSS, and the TMDB API.

homePage.subtitle: Guess the movie from a single frame.

objective.title: Objective
objective.text: Guess the movie title from a blurred frame. You have 5 rounds and 3 lives. Each correct guess earns points based on difficulty and speed!

gameplay.title: How to Play
gameplay.lives: You have 3 lives - lose one for each wrong answer
gameplay.timer: The faster you answer, the more bonus points you earn
gameplay.input: Type your guess and press Submit or hit Enter

languageWarning.title: Use the original title
languageWarning.text: Guesses must use the film's original-language title (no translations).

hints.title: Hints & Reveals
hints.text: Use hints strategically to help identify the movie:
hints.year: Release Year - When the movie came out
hints.blur: Blur Reveal - Reduces blur by one level (0-4 scale)
hints.maxBlur: You can reveal up to level 4 (fully clear)
hints.cost: Each hint and blur reveal costs points

scoring.title: Scoring System
scoring.timeBonus: Time Bonus: Up to 50 points (decreases every 2 seconds)
scoring.penalties: Penalties: Hints and reveals subtract points

easy.name: Easy Mode
easy.maxHints: Use up to 4 hints/reveals per round

medium.name: Medium Mode
medium.maxHints: Use up to 4 hints/reveals per round

tips.title: Pro Tips
tips.tip1: Start with cheaper hints like Genre or Year
tips.tip2: Save blur reveals for when you're close to guessing
tips.tip3: Speed matters - answer quickly for bonus points
tips.tip4: Hard mode requires strategic hint usage
